title: Decoding Frozen Vision Representations for Training-Free Few-Shot Pineapple Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.28442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Few-shot object detection in agricultural imagery is hampered by dense vegetation, repeated patterns, and scarce annotations. We present a training-free detector that turns dense features from frozen visual foundation models directly into detections, without fine-tuning, a learned head, or external proposals: a whitened foreground-background direction estimated from annotated support images scores every query patch, and the score field is decoded with an adaptive threshold and support-derived geometry. We also test whether predicted relative depth can be fed directly to RGB-pretrained frozen encoders. On aerial pineapple imagery, the detector outperforms PET-DINO and GeCo2 at every evaluated support size; at K=40, predicted depth alone reaches 92% of the RGB performance with DINOv2, and RGB-depth fusion lowers counting error for both encoders. translated_title: 解码冻结视觉表征以实现免训练少样本菠萝检测
translated_abstract: 农业图像中的少样本目标检测受到茂密植被、重复纹理模式和标注稀缺的阻碍。我们提出了一种免训练检测器，它将冻结视觉基础模型的密集特征直接转化为检测结果，无需微调、无需学习的检测头、也无需外部候选提议：通过从带标注的支持图像中估计的白化前景-背景方向为每个查询图像块打分，再利用自适应阈值和支持集派生的几何信息对该评分场进行解码。我们还测试了预测的相对深度是否可以直接输入到RGB预训练的冻结编码器中。在航拍菠萝图像上，该检测器在所有评估的支持集大小下均优于PET-DINO和GeCo2；在K=40时，仅使用预测深度就能达到DINOv2下RGB性能的92%，且RGB-深度融合降低了两种编码器的计数误差。我们发布了菠萝种植园数据集（4,908张航拍图像，其中1,995张带有标注，共17,609个标注）。
tldr: 提出一种免训练的少样本菠萝检测方法，直接将冻结视觉基础模型的密集特征解码为检测结果而无需任何微调，在航拍菠萝图像上超越PET-DINO和GeCo2，并发布了菠萝种植园数据集。
en_tdlr: A training-free few-shot detector that directly decodes dense features from frozen vision foundation models into detections, outperforming PET-DINO and GeCo2 on aerial pineapple imagery, with a new Pineapple Plantation dataset released.
